Review: Battery easily lasts two full days with heavy use and the charger tops it up quickly. Camera detail in daylight is excellent and the AMOLED display stays bright outdoors.
Gaming performance is smooth at medium settings and the phone barely warms up. Build feels solid for the price and the fingerprint sensor unlocks instantly.
Display is gorgeous with deep blacks and vivid colours. Battery comfortably lasts a day and a half even with constant streaming.
Camera is the highlight for me, portrait shots look natural and not over sharpened. Software is mostly clean and battery life is dependable.
Feels premium in the hand and performance handles multitasking without stutter. Speakers are surprisingly loud for this segment.
The camera is excellent but the battery drains faster than I expected during long video calls. Acceptable overall for the price.
Charging speed is unbelievable, empty to full in a little over half an hour. The display is smooth at high refresh rate and the design looks classy.
Good all rounder. Daytime photos are sharp and performance stays fluid across daily apps and light gaming sessions.
Speaker output is clear and the in hand feel is comfortable for one handed use. Battery lasts a full working day.
Performance is fine and the display is decent, but low light camera output is noisy and the plastic back picks up scratches quickly. Average overall.
The phone heats up badly during gaming and while charging, and battery capacity dropped noticeably after a year. Disappointed at this price.
Camera struggles indoors and photos come out grainy. Also started facing random app crashes after the last software update.
Sound quality is acceptable for casual listening and the battery lasts a long time between charges, but the fit is loose on a smaller head.
The left ear cup developed a crackling noise within three weeks. Bluetooth also keeps disconnecting when I walk a few steps from my desk.
Bass is muddy and the mids sound hollow. The headband material started peeling within two months of light use.
Bluetooth connectivity drops constantly during calls and the microphone makes me sound distant to the other person. Very frustrating.
Build quality is flimsy and the hinge cracked while folding it normally for storage. The battery also stopped holding charge properly.
Sound turns tinny at higher volume and there is a constant hiss in quiet passages. The charging port stopped responding after a month.
